name: mobile-app-builder
description: Build iOS and Android apps with Expo

interface.longDescription: A skills-only, end-to-end mobile app builder for Expo SDK 54 and React Native. Research and validate an idea, define the smallest useful release, design the experience, implement and test iOS and Android, handle permissions and offline states, prepare monetization and analytics, improve ASO and retention, plan paid acquisition, and prepare EAS builds and store submissions. It provides guidance and local project workflows only: no embedded credentials, hosted execution, telemetry, account system, ad spend, or store submission is performed by the package.
capabilities: Plan Expo iOS and Android apps
Build and audit React Native features
Prepare testing, growth, and store releases
defaultPrompt: Plan my Expo app for iOS and Android: scope, architecture, risks, and proof.
Build or audit one Expo feature with loading, empty, error, offline, accessibility, and platform checks.
Plan app growth across activation, retention, monetization, ASO, and paid acquisition.
